title: Stack & Balance
pitch: Build a tower from awkward blocks and keep it stable while the table gives a small, announced nudge.
capabilities: Measured objectives rather than visual guesses
rules: Place a prescribed block sequence; release each block before selecting another.
Success requires all target blocks supported above the line for a fixed dwell interval and surviving one bounded nudge.
Only toy objects are simulated. Slow-motion practice is a named rule setting, not display-dependent physics.
content: Ten challenges with increasing shape variety, height targets and two difficulty settings.

actions.phone: Tap block then drag placement target
actions.xr: Hand or ray grab constrained to build region

rive.role: Stability instrument and announcer on the bench, not an authoritative physics solver.

polish: Show center-of-mass projection as an optional teaching overlay
tests: Dwell counts only when objective predicates hold continuously.
Nudge occurs once and uses model coordinates.
Dropped input cannot leave a block attached forever.
Measure height from colliders, not decorative Rive art.
Save before nudge restores its timer.
AR placement changes neither mass nor support predicates.
loop: apply bounded target and release operation
commit success/collapse and drive non-authoritative stability meter
save: Same-build world snapshot plus sequence, dwell, nudge and progress counters.
xr_presentation: Reachable building board; optional hand grabbing, always with ray/button alternative.
comfort: No head-follow camera and no forced camera shake on collapse.
documentKind: Same-build world snapshot plus sequence, dwell, nudge and progress counters.
